resources.string: Own mail server

For a mail server of your own. Its settings are read only from your domain: its SRV records, then its usual host names (mail., imap., smtp.). Your address is not sent to Mozilla, Microsoft or any other directory. An untrusted certificate is shown for you to check before anything is saved.
I2P mail (mail.i2p)

Anonymous mail with Postman over the I2P network. FairEmail runs its own I2P router on this device: nothing else to install or set up, though it costs battery. The first start can take a few minutes. Or use a router on a server of your own.

Synchronize only while the device is unlocked

Saves battery: locking the device stops synchronizing, unlocking checks for new messages at once. No new message notifications arrive while locked. The I2P router on this device stops after 5 minutes locked.
